scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w apps/mf-auth -w apps/mf-home -w apps/mf-emergency -w apps/mf-hospital -w apps/mf-ambulatorio -w apps/mf-auditoria
scripts.preview:remotes: concurrently -n auth,home,emergency,hospital,ambulatorio,auditoria -c magenta,green,red,blue,yellow,white "npm --workspace apps/mf-auth run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-home run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-emergency run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-hospital run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-ambulatorio run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-auditoria run preview"
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/mf-auth/dist apps/mf-home/dist apps/mf-shell/dist apps/mf-emergency/dist apps/mf-hospital/dist apps/mf-ambulatorio/dist apps/mf-auditoria/dist
scripts.start: npm run clean && npm run build:remotes && npm run build:shell && concurrently -n remotes,shell -c bgBlue,bgGreen "npm run preview:remotes" "npm run preview:shell"
